_comment: klt erc supply-connectivity spec for layout/evidence/pll-top-layout/pll_top.gds (gf180mcuD), ties-grading variant (issue #1085). Same stackup/vias/nets as the committed ../erc-supply-spec.json, with two deltas: (1) stackup entry names use the gf180mcu antenna table's canonical spelling (Metal1..Metal5) so '--pdk gf180mcu' grades the antenna half (klayout-tools#6976; same rename as ../erc-antenna-20261120/erc-supply-spec.json); (2) the tool_limitation ties_disclosure is replaced by a computed five-class ties[] partition of the assembly's forty merged Nwell (21/0) shapes, selected per placement with the literal well-side selectors of klayout-tools#2540. The committed spec at the parent path stays byte-unchanged so ../erc-report.json keeps resolving its own provenance.spec.content_hash.

stackup.name: poly2
stackup._comment: Poly2 (30/0), gate poly; active_layer Comp (22/0). Same as every block-level spec.

stackup.name: Metal1
stackup._comment: Metal1 (34/0) via Contact (33/0). 34/10 (Metal1_Label) carries the blocks' own supply pin text in the assembled GDS (VDD 30, VSS 32, GND_VCO 28, VDD_VCO 15, VDD_DIV 1 instances, counted with klayout.db over the flattened top cell).

stackup.name: Metal2
stackup._comment: Metal2 (36/0) via Via1 (35/0). 36/10 carries one VDD and one VSS text in the assembled GDS.

stackup.name: Metal3
stackup._comment: Metal3 (42/0) via Via2 (38/0). No 42/10 text is drawn in this GDS.

stackup.name: Metal4
stackup._comment: Metal4 (46/0) via Via3 (40/0): the top-level signal and supply routing layer (layout/evidence/pll-top-layout/PROOF.md).

stackup.name: Metal5
stackup._comment: Metal5 (81/0) via Via4 (41/0): the top-level supply pins. 81/10 carries exactly one text per supply (VSS, VDD, VDD_VCO, GND_VCO, VDD_DIV).

nets.name: VDD
nets._comment: Digital supply of pfd_cp and lock_detector; the netcheck records it as a star of two branches meeting at one pad, i.e. one electrical island.

nets.name: VSS
nets._comment: Shared ground of every block except the VCO.

nets.name: GND_VCO
nets._comment: VCO ground, its own pin; shares the p-substrate with VSS (PROOF.md 'GND_VCO and VSS').

ties.name: nwell_vdd
ties._comment: Fifteen wells: lock_detector's one assembly-level VDD tub plus pfd_cp's fourteen (everything pfd_cp draws on Nwell except its PSRC tub). Each box is the instance transform applied to an interior point of one child-cell well, so the list follows the placement; the pfd_cp instance is mirrored (m90). Counted and reconciled against the merged top-level geometry in RECORD.md.

ties.name: nwell_vdd_div
ties._comment: The divider_chain's fourteen Nwell shapes at their placed (r180) positions; the same class the block's own ../divider-chain-layout/erc-supply-spec.json declares and grades.

ties.name: nwell_vdd_vco
ties._comment: vco_block's six Nwell shapes (including the large outer tub) at their placed (r0) positions; the same class the block's own ../vco-layout/erc-supply-spec.json declares and grades.

ties.name: nwell_vss_cap_body
ties._comment: The four loop-filter cap_nmos_03v3_b body tubs, tied to VSS through their diffusion contact columns. The extra Contact (33/0) narrowing is required here and only here: the cap cell draws Nplus over the whole Comp body (layout/pll_top/loop_filter/primitives.py mos_cap), so Comp-and-Nplus alone names no distinguishable tap inside these wells and klt 0.9.2 would skip the class as degenerate_tap_declaration; intersecting Contact keeps exactly the physical body-contact columns.

ties.name: nwell_psrc
ties._comment: pfd_cp's dump-buffer pfet body tub at its placed (m90) position, top bbox (372.950, 21.600)-(475.950, 26.400) um. No PSRC label exists anywhere in the assembly, and klt erc matches a tie's target net by label, so the expected outcome is a computed erc.missing_tie finding on this well -- the same finding the block-level run reports, now at assembly coordinates. The five entries together partition all forty drawn Nwell shapes disjointly and exhaustively.
